user.title: Set up SOLBUDDY Access
user.description: Initialize local grants and owner-only management APIs. Guest access defaults off; enable it separately in options after configuring direct HTTPS.

error.storage_unavailable: Local storage could not be initialized. Check storage health and try again.

abort.owner_required: An authenticated, active Home Assistant owner must perform setup.

init.title: Guest access
init.description: Guest access defaults off. HTTPS can be direct or through an explicitly trusted proxy. Optional local HTTP sends credentials and commands without encryption. Local networks are detected automatically from Home Assistant enabled private network interfaces. Reloading invalidates all guest credentials. Wallet login requires HTTPS and a separate opt-in. Prices older than five minutes are rejected. Owner and guest wallet pages are documented in the installation guide.

data.guest_origin: HTTPS origin (optional when local HTTP is enabled)
data.https_proxy_ips: HTTPS proxy IP addresses (comma-separated; also trust these in HA)
data.wallet_enabled: Enable owner-approved wallets (Phantom, Solflare, Trust; US$2 SBUD minimum)

error.invalid_https_origin: Check the origins and proxy IPs. Submit from a connection allowed by these settings. Local HTTP must come from a detected Home Assistant private network; forwarded HTTPS needs a proxy trusted by both HA and SOLBUDDY.
error.local_network_unavailable: Home Assistant did not report a usable private network. Check its enabled network interfaces under Settings → System → Network, then retry. Local HTTP remains blocked.

abort.owner_required: An authenticated, active Home Assistant owner must change guest options.
abort.security_gate_closed: Guest access is disabled until the implementation security tests pass.
